## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

The *Cakkhuviññāṇādipañha* ("The Question on the Process of Visual Cognition") is a dialogue in the *Milindapañha*. It examines psychological and cognitive processes, specifically the nature and occurrence of visual cognition (*cakkhuviññāṇa*) and mental cognition. Modern English translations of the text include one by John Kelly.

In the Chinese Buddhist canon, the text has a direct parallel in the *Nagasena Bhikṣu Sūtra*, preserved at T 1670b 2.29 under the title "Visual-consciousness and Mental-consciousness".
